answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 16415 Country: India Title: AOK,janab,from last 10 yrs i have been suffering from panic disorder.i cant travel in any public transport.i am married & have 2 kids.i have been taking medicines regularly,but now they are not working.i fear very mutch when i am alone,i cant sleep alone.all the day my concentration is on myself,i think who i am,i cant look into the mirror.i offer salat 5 times daily,read tasbihat also,i am living avery stressful life,i also had bad dreams at night.pl.tell me if theres any solution for rest of my life.a humble request to you all pl. pray for me & my family very sternly.ALLAH HAFIZ.THANKS Question: AOK,janab,from last 10 yrs i have been suffering from panic disorder.i cant travel in any public transport.i am married & have 2 kids.i have been taking medicines regularly,but now they are not working.i fear very mutch when i am alone,i cant sleep alone.all the day my concentration is on myself,i think who i am,i cant look into the mirror.i offer salat 5 times daily,read tasbihat also,i am living avery stressful life,i also had bad dreams at night.pl.tell me if theres any solution for rest of my life.a humble request to you all pl. pray for me & my family very sternly.ALLAH HAFIZ.THANKS Answer ID: 16415 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1900/1496/D=1430) We pray for you and family members, may Allah grant you aafiyah . Recite Surah Fatihah, four Quls and Ayatul Kursi, blow your hands and pass on the hands over the body. Also, keep on praying: أ عوذ باللہ من غضبہ وعقابہ وشر عبادہ وھمزات الشیاطین وأن یحضرون Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
